proposal.name: 敵指揮機を撃破せよ

legend.#: impassable terrain (proposed to block movement and line of sight)

tacticalLayoutIntent: A central three-cell obstacle segment prevents straight frontal movement from D8/F8 toward E2.
Left flank via C5 and right flank via G5 both remain traversable. Avoid a single forced route.
Gunner has a right-side firing lane; guard occupies the boss's near front-left.
board.obstacleRules: proposed: impassable for all units and obstructs ordinary line of sight; use game-wide definition when fixed
board.coordDistance: use final game-wide distance metric; not independently fixed here

rounds.timeoutResolution: after complete ninth round unless boss already defeated
rounds.reason: Allows flank/assault route while maintaining actual possibility of failing by inaction

enemySetup.equipmentModel: enemy final stats and native weapons; do not consume player part inventory
enemySetup.preserveEnemyRoles: M01 guard and gunner stats reused; only commander is a new enemy type

win.evaluate: after resolving the current completed action, rather than after each damage sub-hit

proposal.tiebreakUnresolved: If boss and last allied unit die in the same resolved action, result priority requires a global rule (do not silently choose a winner).

subobjective.description: 敵護衛機2機のうち1機以上を生存させた状態で指揮機を撃破
subobjective.note: M02の従来の「護衛生存」を操作可能な目標として具体化する案。敵を倒さない方が有利になることを保証せず、敵護衛を残すリスクを伴う

globalPolicy: Every enemy uses normal legal move + action; no deliberate surrender or automatic reduction in incoming damage near death.
If a legal attack is available after choosing a move, prefer attacking over idling.
Lethal target attacks take priority when tactically legal, subject to fixed role priorities.
Tie breakers must be deterministic and visible to tests; exact global speed/turn order remains unresolved.

commander.preferredTargets: allied units threatening boss or already within firing range

guard.moveTarget: closest legal tile that can engage a nearby ally threatening commander while staying near boss when possible
guard.targetPriority: ally in range that can attack commander, else ordinary lethal/damage target

gunner.targetPriority: killable ally, else nearest highest-threat ally within shootable line

implementationDependencies: global turn order, path and line-of-sight need final movement rules
AI must evaluate actual legal movement/range instead of using scripted guaranteed outcomes
no scripted escapes/reinforcements/healing triggered by approaching victory

balanceSanity.referenceBuilds: same three valid CAP<=100 initial builds as M01
balanceSanity.formula: floor(10 * (attack stat + weapon power) / target DEF)
balanceSanity.note: Raw unmodified single-target normal-attack arithmetic only; excludes movement, actual turns, guard positioning, line-of-sight, EN and other actions. Not a win-rate simulation.

whyThisIsDifferentFromM01: Destroy the commander; escort kills are optional rather than required.
A three-cell central obstruction creates left/right approaches and a shot-line tradeoff.
Secondary objective encourages selective target removal: keep an escort alive at greater risk.
Boss remains dangerous and will attack, with no invulnerable phase or rescue mechanic.
openIssues: Confirm 9-round limit, commander stats, three-block map, exact 'escort alive' subobjective as game-design decisions.
Shared line-of-sight, move geometry, turn order, starting equipment choice, draw-state/dual-death judgment remain unimplemented or unsettled.
AI is a role-based design proposal; no autonomous gameplay executable code exists yet.
No match simulation/win-rate test was run; calibrate after core rules stabilize.
